teacher_info.introduction:
My goals in teaching you English are the following: 1. Communication: Language is a social activity. As such, it is important that you have the means to interact with other human beings using in this case the English language. Therefore, you will practice formally reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Furthermore, you will eventually practice informal and colloquial English so as to better comprehend and communicate with native English speakers from the United States. 2. Participation: You will be the one using the English language during our sessions. My job is to prepare the lesson for you and your job is to be ready and willing to use English. I will not judge you but I will help you to improve your English language skills through repetition and your active participation; in fact, having learned language myself here on Italki, I understand how important it is for you to have a patient and supportive teacher. 3. Cultural Immersion: I believe that language exists in a cultural context. For those of you who are interested, I will provide you with contemporary media meant to teach you the English language in a north American context. Moreover, I can provide you with suitable literature to examine, too.

My promises to you: 1. During our first lesson, I will evaluate your English level. I will plan your lessons accordingly so that they are not too difficult, but at the same time will challenge you enough that your English will improve. 2. I will prepare each and every lesson for you beforehand. Each lesson will have a particular outcome in mind. 3. I will adapt our lessons to your particular goals. Are you preparing for an English language exam? Or are you planning to travel or to undertake business in an English- speaking country? In both cases the lessons I will plan will be different. 4. I cannot promise that you will become fluent in only a few months, but I can promise you that your English will improve steadily with your hard work.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing & Editing: Personal Statements, SOPs, and Academic Writing Samples (MBA, PhD, Master's)
pro_course_detail.description:
I specialize in applications for American & UK colleges and graduate programs, including MBA, PhD, and Master's applications. My writing lessons help students develop strong academic writing samples, well-organized statements of purpose, and creative personal essays. We will work together to customize your essay and make your application stand out from the crowd of other candidates. 

When editing an essay, I usually work in two rounds: 

Round 1: We focus on the essay content, including the organization, flow, relevant examples, creativity, and more. My goal is to make your writing unique, powerful, and convincing. In this round, I ask students to send me their draft 24 hours before our class. I will read your essay in advance, then we meet for a video call to discuss my comments and suggestions as well as your questions. After our class, you make further changes to your draft. 

Round 2:  I edit your essay to make it perfect. I fix errors with grammar, phrasing, vocabulary, repetition, transitions, etc.  I prefer to do editing lessons offline, as it is more efficient than meeting for a video call to edit together. 

Please feel free to message me if you have any questions about this process. I look forward to working with you!

Please note: We can usually look at between 500-1000 words per lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Coaching: University Admissions Interview Preparation (MBA, PhD, Master's)

These lessons are designed to help students build confidence and fluency in preparation for a university admissions interview. I frequently work with students applying to UK and American PhD, MA, and MBA programs. I also have experience coaching for US medical residency interviews. 

In the lesson, we will practice a variety of interview questions specific to your school or program, do mock interviews together, and help you select and highlight your unique strengths and interests that will set you apart from other candidates. I have experience helping students prepare for both face-to-face interviews and KIRA assessments. 

In each lesson, I will provide feedback on your strengths as well as suggestions for how you can improve. Most students take 2-8 lessons to prepare for an interview.

If you are interested in this lesson, please send me a message to introduce yourself when you book the class. Please also tell me the name of the university and/or academic program to which you are applying, so I can prepare questions relevant to your program.

pro_course_detail.title: Improve Your Vocabulary, Accent and Pronunciation with Texts
pro_course_detail.description:
This format is best for those who want to expand their vocabulary and improve their accent.  Many people do not know that accent is more than just your pronunciation; it also includes your intonation patterns, the rhythm of your speech, and the fluency of your speech.  You can have perfect pronunciation but still not sound like a native if you lacking in the other areas of your speech.  

These classes are made to specifically work on accent reduction and building your vocabulary.  To do this, we will use text a digital text which you will read it aloud.  We will focus on specific vowel and consonant sounds , syllable and word stress, and rhythm patters to help you sound more like a native.  

Since we will be using native level content, you will also be exposed to new vocabulary, phrases and sayings.  We will discuss the text and I will help you with any doubts you have.  The texts will be on topics of interest to you so that you can use the vocabulary in your daily life.  The possibilities are endless and include:
- News articles
- Blog posts
- Short stories
- Passages from novels

You can also bring any material that you like, for example a book you are reading, a text for work, a novel for school, etc.  As long as you have the text in a digital format, we can use it in our sessions.
